_note: size_m = [x width, y depth, z height] in metres, Blender axes (Godot: x, z, y). Fronts face Blender -Y (Godot +Z). Origin on the ground at the footprint centre (the Watch keeps the old signpost's origin, on the post). collision = footprint seen from above (box size_m = [x, y], circle radius_m); null = walk-through. parts = child nodes the game moves or hides, origin at their pivot. The Phase D Gloom Raid props (docs/PHASE_D_SPEC.md section 19).

props.name: signpost_watch
props.notes: The Watch (camp signpost once raids are open): the old signpost face for face (same origin on the post, readable side -Y, swaps in place) with a cradle on top holding a big curled cream horn (bell to +Y, north), a twig cage under the left arm with the crystal column, three ribbon hooks on the crossbar front, a flag socket on its right end. Parts, all children of the root: `fill` = the violet crystal column, origin at its base (scale its local Y, Godot, 0.06..1.0), 0.476 m tall; `horn` origin at the cradle (blow bounce); `lookout_flag` (green pennant on a stick, origin at the stick foot) and `tracker_bell` (bronze bell on an iron eye, origin at the eye) - hide each until owned; `ribbon_1` gold, `ribbon_2` green, `ribbon_3` white (origin at the hook) - hide until streaks 3, 5, 10. The GLB has every part visible: the game hides them.

props.name: gloom_shard
props.notes: Gloom shard pickup / level 4 cap crystal: one faceted violet crystal standing on its lower tip, pale lilac core facets in violet frames, a thin gold glint on the front-right edge. Origin at the lower tip (ground); its centre is 0.09 m up. Front facet faces -Y.

props.name: rubble_pile
props.notes: Wear rubble at a building's foot: broken planks, two stones and three small violet crystal chips on a dusty patch. Walk-through (no blocking).

props.name: barricade_shard
props.notes: Level 4 road barricade (Shardstone): the thorn hedge rebuilt on a low footing of dressed grey stones between five posts crowned with violet-white shards (two more shards set into the front of two posts), four crystal-tipped stakes leaning out to the front, pale thorns and a few shard thorns on the hedge. Spans the trail along X; the front (-Y, Godot +Z) faces the enemies (world.gd barricade_slots() turns local +Z toward the woods). Origin on the ground at the centre of the wall.

props.name: acorn_tower_4
props.notes: Level 4: the level 3 tower (stone base, lantern, gold-banded crossbow, leaf banner) with a crown of pale shard crystals standing out of the roof ring, a crystal lens in a gold ring on two struts over the loaded acorn (part of `turret`, turns with it), pale green vines climbing the front posts and binding the back posts. Faces no camera from 12 degrees up can see were dropped. Lookout tower, front faces -Y, ladder at the back (+Y). `turret` = the crossbow, origin on its vertical turning axis at the top of the fixed collar, aims -Y; rotate it about its local up axis. `marker_shoot` (child of turret) = bolt tip, where the acorn leaves. `banner` origin at its hanging rod (swing it about local X).

props.name: thorn_spikes_4
props.notes: Ground trap (walk-over, no blocking). Trap area ~1.4 x 1.0 m. Level 4: the level 3 thorn bed with eight violet crystal thorns among the wooden stakes.
